group: TMP, ARE, AED (Tempo/meter; audio recording; audio editing)

features.capabilityEvidence: Tracktion edit.tempoSequence drives timing; snapshot reads getBpmAt at MoshOps.cpp:1252. No set-tempo command; default tempo only, never user-settable.
features.surfaceEvidence: tempo is in types.ts:99 snapshot type but never rendered. Transport.tsx shows only play/loop/pos; no tempo field anywhere in ui/src.

features.capabilityEvidence: No tempo map / tempo-automation code; tempoSequence is read once via getBpmAt(t=0) only (MoshOps.cpp:1252). No command to add tempo changes.
features.surfaceEvidence: No tempo track or curve in Arrangement.tsx; ruler ticks are seconds (Arrangement.tsx:92-96). none found.

features.capabilityEvidence: No time-signature handling; grep for timeSignature/numerator/denominator across src returns none. Snapshot has no meter field.
